unit.why: A short anecdote: the Dinover rebbe at Zhidachov refuses to eat potatoes, and R. Zvi tells him the food will one day feed many people, a prediction that came true.

stories.start_quote: עו״ש כאשר הגאוה״ק רצ"א מדינוב הי' בזידיטשוב
stories.summary_en: When R. Zvi Elimelekh of Dinov visited Zhidachov and declined to eat the new food, potatoes, his relative by marriage R. Zvi Hirsh urged him to eat, foretelling that many people in their land would live from it, which came true.

tags.why: the arc is a prediction that is fulfilled
